title: House rent parties during the Depression
summary: He and his mother played the rent-party circuit with Dan Grissom, and they were paid.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: But also I used to play house rent parties. This was during the Depression, and we would -- my mother would play these house rent parties, I would play, and Dan Grissom. We used to go -- we used to book house rent parties, and they'd have poker games, and whatever, you know, and they'd sell home brew and --
Oh, we got paid, yeah, we got paid. I was told musicians just got to eat and drink.
No, no, we got paid. We were booked, you know, we were that good. You worked the rent party circuit.
